audience: DCCE (กรม สส.) executives and policy owners reading the Executive Summary Report
decision_use: Understand, in brief, why the data ecosystem currently has gaps and obstacles, and what that means for developing each of the 9 climate information services and the department's website content
section_job: Give a short, front-loaded summary of gaps and obstacles across the data ecosystem, per-service development obstacles, and website content gaps -- setting up the chapter's problem statement before section 4.2 develops the A-BTR-specific argument in full
target_altitude: One to two paragraphs of policy-level summary; no per-field metadata or full dataset enumeration
report_specific_rules: Full Thai+English agency name at first mention ("กรมการเปลี่ยนแปลงสภาพภูมิอากาศและสิ่งแวดล้อม"), then only "กรม สส." thereafter -- never bare "สส." without "กรม" leading it

Never bare English "NCAIF" -- give the full Thai name at first mention ("โครงสร้างข้อมูลด้านการปรับตัวต่อการเปลี่ยนแปลงสภาพภูมิอากาศของประเทศ (National Climate Adaptation Information Framework: NCAIF)"), then use "โครงสร้างข้อมูลด้านการปรับตัวฯ" or "โครงสร้างข้อมูล NCAIF"
No internal jargon abbreviations (TOR70, CRDB) without spelling out at first use

No internal document locators (slide numbers, page numbers, superseded internal section references) in narrative prose -- cite by document name, E-xxx evidence code, or named standard; locators live in evidence-traceability only

Use "คณะที่ปรึกษา" as the active subject for study/survey/interview/workshop/analysis/synthesis/design-decision sentences; avoid passive voice or "โครงการ" as actor except for contractual objective/scope statements
Countable parallel items formatted as numbered/bulleted lists with substantive descriptions, not run-on prose
Executive-summary substance retention: cut operational/technical detail but never reduce a point to one floating sentence; each subsection needs Why/What/So-What in 1-2 paragraphs
Formal official vocabulary ("ข้อมูลอภิพันธ์"/"ข้อมูลกำกับ", "สถาปัตยกรรมสารสนเทศ", "ธรรมาภิบาลข้อมูล"); avoid colloquial phrasing

No contrastive/justify-by-flaw scaffolding -- never justify a point by first negating a bad alternative ("แทนที่จะ...", "เพื่อป้องกัน...", "เพื่อลดความเสี่ยง...", "หลีกเลี่ยง..."); state findings and their implications directly
inclusions: brief summary of gaps and obstacles across the data ecosystem

website content gap summary, including the 75-topic readiness split (16 full / 26 partial / 33 gap -> 79% needs fresh synthesis) against the 391-item digital asset inventory -- this is a whole-website figure, not A-BTR-specific, and belongs here rather than in 4.2 (Boss correction, 2026-08-30)
exclusions: full enumerated table of the 260 datasets
the full A-BTR argument (belongs to section 4.2)
evidence_policy: Use verified figures from WP7 Gap Analysis Report, WP4 Content-Source Gap Analysis v2, DCCE Unified Digital Asset Database, and WP6 Service Intelligence v6.0 in prose; keep internal locators and per-source detail in the evidence-traceability sidecar
required_concepts: 75-topic content readiness split (16 full / 26 partial / 33 gap) against the 391-item digital asset inventory -- the whole-website content-gap figure
